reviewer_statement: Developer-side frozen Python 1.2 exact source scientific manuscript review for functional_mixed_effects_reporting_text. The 21 distinct direct output comparisons span the two related reporters with typed Python dataclasses, two CV rules, three precision values, three inference cases and explicit native invalid-domain tests. native_language_semantic_policy: Validated Python scientific result dataclasses map to checked native R list/data.frame scientific records, and Python str maps to R scalar character; all reporting text is Python-free at native runtime. The nested selection-and-fit and conditional-versus-full-refit inference claims are preserved.

case_evidence.description: Frozen Python 1.2 reporting.py source signature and typed scientific result records; native R source semantic map with keyword defaults and return string.

Three scenarios each: no-band iid/grouped CV, conditional-coefficient bootstrap with AR1 and random slope, full-refit bootstrap with exponential trial random effects; CV selection minimum/one_se and multiple precisions.
21 distinct Python 1.2 typed source-to-native reporting comparisons: 18 CV variants and 3 mixed-effects narratives with exact numerical text and Python repr of Unicode scientific labels.
Native R rejects invalid CV selection policy and precision, undeclared CV scope, missing/malformed scientific mixed fit flags, covariance and incompatible bootstrap-band source reference.
One exact ordered source manuscript text string per call, correct held-out CV loss/SE, data family repr, coefficient-band scope and variance-component uncertainty wording.

Joint Gaussian functional mixed-effects model with REML/ML, participant and trial random effects, AR(1)/exponential residual dependence, conditional-covariance versus full-refit participant bootstrap distinction.
